subject: Scheduling: Mosaic + Redwood joint solution deep-dive & deployment runbook
messages:
From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@mosaiccloud.ai>

Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudory.com>, marketplace-biz@mosaiccloud.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:12:07 -0800
Subject: Joint deployment / architecture deep-dive 

Hi Mateo / Marissa —

Thanks for the call last week. Mosaic's integration engineering team would like to run a 90-minute technical deep-dive next week so our architects and your runtime engineers can map the end-to-end deployment and agree on the runbook for marketplace delivery. High-level goals:

- Validate network and VPC peering patterns for Redwood Private (VPC) + Mosaic ingress
- Walk through model packaging / quantization artifacts we want to publish to the marketplace
- Confirm auth/KMS flow and audit log collection for compliance

We've attached a first-pass integration spec and a short list of questions we want to cover. Our folks are available: Tue 10–13 PDT or Wed 08–11 PDT. Does that work for you?

Attaching: Mosaic_Integration_Specs_v0.9.pdf

Thanks,
Rajiv
Principal Architect, MosaicCloud
rajiv.singh@mosaiccloud.ai

Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:03:12 -08:00
Subject: Re: Joint deployment / architecture deep-dive 

Thanks Rajiv — this is perfect context. Tue 10–13 PDT would be my preference; I can block 90 minutes at 10:00–11:30 to give us time for a short recap and then the deep-dive.

Quick asks before we lock the invite:
- Can you confirm who will present the Mosaic networking diagram (name + title) so we can include the right Redwood engineers?
- Are you expecting a live demo of your packaging flow, or is a static artifact + Q&A sufficient?

I've looped in Camila (marketplace lead) and Sergio (runtime eng) so they can scope any infra pre-reqs. Marissa, can you handle the calendar invite and add the draft agenda I uploaded? I put a stub in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBv--mosaic-redwood-arch

I attached a one-page agenda template to speed scheduling: Redwood_Solution-Workshop-Agenda.docx

—Mateo

Subject: Re: Joint deployment / architecture deep-dive 

Hi Mateo —

I'll present the Cloudory marketplace requirements and touch on our packaging expectations. Rajiv will cover the model artifact flow. A quick note on attendees from our side: myself (Director, Cloud Solutions), Rajiv (Principal Architect), and Priya Kaur (Marketplace Ops) — Priya's email is priya@cloudory.com and she'll help with publishing steps.

We prefer Tue 10:00–11:30 PDT. We can do a live screen-share of the packaging UI for ~15 minutes; otherwise we can keep it as an artifact.

Also, small ask: can you send any required VPC peering CIDR ranges or firewall rules in advance so our security team can pre-clear? If Sergio can flag the minimum inbound ports and KMS endpoints, that would help speed validation.

Best,
Elena

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudory.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@mosaiccloud.ai>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:12:44 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint deployment / architecture deep-dive 

Thanks — adding some concrete pre-reqs below so support teams can triage before the call:

1) VPC peering / network
- Redwood needs the marketplace egress IP range for our outbound NAT (we can NAT-exempt if you prefer). Please confirm CIDR(s).
- Required inbound: 443 from Cloudory control-plane (for manifest fetch), TCP 22 only for scheduled debug windows (we will not open 22 by default).

2) KMS / keys
- We'll use a customer-managed KMS alias for production artifacts. Please confirm your accepted KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).

3) Audit logs
- We push audit logs to an S3-compatible endpoint; please provide an endpoint URL and a pre-signed PUT pattern or we can set up an IAM role for cross-account puts.

I've attached a small ICS with the proposed event and an attendee list placeholder: calendar-invite-rcpt-list.ics

If that looks good I'll join the call to walk the runtime constraints (~20m) and then hand off to Mateo for the packaging discussion.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
